metadata.description: CloudGuard Comprehensive Audit Dataset - Enterprise Cloud Architecture with 15 Planted Flaws

environment.notes: DEMO DATA — SIMULATED, NOT A LIVE AWS SCAN. Ground-truth benchmark dataset.

findings.description: S3 bucket is open to the public (ACL grant to AllUsers)
findings.remediation: Make the ACL private and turn on S3 Block Public Access across all 4 controls.

findings.description: S3 bucket has no default server-side encryption enabled
findings.remediation: Turn on default encryption (SSE-S3 AES-256 or SSE-KMS CMK).

findings.description: S3 Block Public Access is not fully enabled at bucket level
findings.remediation: Enable all four S3 Block Public Access configurations.

findings.description: S3 bucket versioning is disabled; vulnerable to ransomware or accidental deletes
findings.remediation: Enable S3 bucket versioning with optional MFA Delete.

findings.description: SSH port 22 is open to the world (0.0.0.0/0)
findings.remediation: Restrict SSH to trusted CIDR blocks (/32) or transition to AWS Systems Manager Session Manager.

findings.description: ALL ingress ports (-1 protocol) open to the internet (0.0.0.0/0)
findings.remediation: Remove wildcard 0.0.0.0/0 ingress rule and scope down to specific application ports.

findings.description: Attached EBS root storage volume is unencrypted
findings.remediation: Take snapshot, copy snapshot with KMS encryption, and create encrypted volume replacement.

findings.description: Privileged administrator user does not have Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enabled
findings.remediation: Enforce virtual FIDO2/WebAuthn or TOTP MFA token registration.

findings.description: IAM user has unrestricted administrator access (*:*) via AdministratorAccess policy
findings.remediation: Detach AdministratorAccess and attach least-privilege role with permission boundaries.

findings.description: Active IAM access key is older than 90 days (2,479 days old)
findings.remediation: Rotate IAM access key immediately and decommission old inactive credentials.

findings.description: Account password policy does not meet CIS AWS Benchmark complexity standards
findings.remediation: Update account password policy: min length 14, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols, 90-day expiry.

findings.description: RDS database instance has public IP assignment and is accessible from the internet
findings.remediation: Modify DB instance setting PubliclyAccessible=false and deploy inside private VPC subnets.

findings.description: RDS relational database storage is unencrypted at rest
findings.remediation: Snapshot unencrypted instance, copy snapshot with AWS KMS CMK encryption, and restore.

findings.description: No active multi-region CloudTrail trail found; API audit logging is disabled
findings.remediation: Create an organization-wide multi-region CloudTrail trail logging all management and data events.

findings.description: Customer managed KMS master key does not have automatic yearly rotation enabled
findings.remediation: Enable annual key rotation via aws kms enable-key-rotation.
